_comment: P0/P0b/P1 + A1/A3/A4/A5 sweep matrix for gemm_decode universal SmallM. The instance headers (universal/gemm_decode_universal_single_default.hpp, universal/gemm_decode_universal_fp8_smallm_pertensor.hpp) are macro-parameterized on the register-tile and swizzle knobs (GEMM_DECODE_M_PER_WARP / _N_PER_WARP / _VECTOR / _CHIPLET_SWIZZLE / _NUM_XCDS / _CHUNK), so gemm_decode_instance_builder.py --gen_single emits one self-contained variant per (m_per_warp, n_per_warp, vector_size, chiplet_swizzle, chiplet_chunk_size) point by writing a header that #defines those knobs and #includes the blueprint. The mp*np<=16 register-footprint prune is enforced in gemm_decode_validation_utils.is_tile_config_valid.
